channel.title: Pier & Point · Retail
channel.description: Retail changes and milestones, for four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront. Every item names its source.

item.title: Status · Verde: Chipotle's own page for its Mission Rock restaurant (365 Toni Stone Xing, Unit C)…
item.description: Chipotle's own page for its Mission Rock restaurant (365 Toni Stone Xing, Unit C) gives an open date of September 23, 2026, with daily hours and online ordering, in data timestamped September 24, 2026. The restaurant was previously shown as announced, on a December 2025 post that expected a 2026 opening. The date is the company's own statement; no news report of the opening was found. Source: https://locations.chipotle.com/ca/san-francisco/365-toni-stone-xing.

item.title: Added · Building B: Fort Point Physical Therapy registered a business location at 1090 Dr Maya…
item.description: Fort Point Physical Therapy registered a business location at 1090 Dr Maya Angelou Ln in July 2026. Source: https://data.sfgov.org/Economy-and-Community/Registered-Business-Locations-San-Francisco/g8m3-pdis.

item.title: Added · 409/499 Illinois Street: Caffe Central (490 Illinois St; SF YIMBY, 2020-11-27, places…
item.description: Caffe Central (490 Illinois St; SF YIMBY, 2020-11-27, places UCSF's Wayne and Gladys Valley Center for Vision at 490 Illinois Street) had been missing and was added, confirmed via the cafe's own site, which publishes this exact address as a location. No opening date found (SF YIMBY reported the building open by Nov 27, 2020, so the cafe can't predate that). It is assigned to the 490-499 Illinois St record, whose sourced address is 490 Illinois St, not the neighboring UCSF Valley Center for Vision (west) record, a separate building about 60-100 m away across the street with an unresolved naming question. DataSF business registrations show no listing for Caffe Central at this address (only one at 460 16th St, presumably a different location of the same small chain), so, like Standard Deviant Brewing, it was a real tenant missing from the registration data. Source: https://www.caffecentral.com/490-illinois-street-mission-bay.

item.title: Added · Building G: Fieldwork Brewing Co. held the grand opening of a 3,750 sq ft full-service…
item.description: Fieldwork Brewing Co. held the grand opening of a 3,750 sq ft full-service taproom at 300 Toni Stone Xing, Suite B, in the Visa building at Mission Rock, its 10th location, adjacent to its China Basin Park Beer Garden; the release, datelined July 28, 2026, says 'Saturday, July 26' (July 26, 2026 was a Sunday). Source: https://www.einpresswire.com/article/929782480/fieldwork-opens-mission-rock-taproom-expanding-its-footprint-in-san-francisco.

item.title: Added · Building B: Grey's Florals announced a retail flower shop to open in August 2026 at 1090…
item.description: Grey's Florals announced a retail flower shop to open in August 2026 at 1090 Dr. Maya Angelou Lane, inside MNT Studio's newest Mission Rock space (What Now, July 21, 2026). No post-opening source has been found. Source: https://whatnow.com/san-francisco/retail/greys-florals-to-open-in-mission-rock/.

item.title: Added · Pier 70 Parcel E3: RASA World's one-day festival Pier Play San Francisco, headlined by…
item.description: RASA World's one-day festival Pier Play San Francisco, headlined by BLOND:ISH, was held on Sep 19, 2026 on Pier 70's Parcel E3. Elevation Sky Park's own page (checked Sep 29, 2026) calls the site 'the future home of Elevation Sky Park', invites sign-ups for opening announcements and gives no opening date; the July 2026 release had said the campus would open in phases beginning September 2026. No source shows the venue itself open. Source: https://elevationskypark.com/.

item.description: Elevation XR announces the venue opens with Pier Play San Francisco on September 19, 2026, with dome programming and additional experiences rolling out in phases (Jul 23, 2026). Source: Business Wire (Elevation XR press release; operator's claim), 2026-07-23; Beatportal, 2026-07-24; Business Wire via Yahoo Finance (Elevation XR press release; operator's claim), 2026-07-23.

item.title: Milestone · Building G: Fieldwork's Mission Rock taproom at 300 Toni Stone Crossing is… (~Jul 2026)
item.description: Fieldwork's Mission Rock taproom at 300 Toni Stone Crossing is open to the public by late July 2026, per the company's July 28 press release (the release gives July 26 but calls it both Saturday and Monday, and July 26, 2026 was a Sunday); the company's September 9 release calls this a soft opening and announces an official grand opening on September 25-27 (~Jul 2026). Source: Fieldwork Brewing Co. (press release, EIN Presswire copy), 2026-07-28; Fieldwork Brewing Company, via EIN Presswire, 2026-09-09; Fieldwork Brewing Company (tenant's own material).
item.source: Fieldwork Brewing Co. (press release, EIN Presswire copy), 2026-07-28; Fieldwork Brewing Company, via EIN Presswire, 2026-09-09; Fieldwork Brewing Company (tenant's own material)

item.title: Milestone · 1450 Owens Street: Gladstone Institutes announced it had secured… (Mar 25, 2026)
item.description: Gladstone Institutes announced it had secured 105,000+ sq ft of laboratory space in the building (about 20 labs for its data science and genomic immunology institutes), with move-in expected in early 2027; Alexandria's executive chairman called Gladstone the anchor tenant. (Mar 25, 2026). Source: Gladstone Institutes, 2026-03-25; Bisnow, 2026-03-25.

item.description: Port Executive Director reports the venue as an interim use 'until we start building housing and other uses at Pier 70', located where 22nd Street meets the Bay, scheduled to open early 2026 (Jul 8, 2025). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2025-07-08.

item.description: Elevation Sky Park community engagement deck: interim activation on Phase 2/3 sites, target opening Q1 2026, five-year duration, to be fully permitted through the Port, 200+ new public parking spaces (Jun 25, 2025). Source: Elevation XR, hosted by the Port of San Francisco, 2025-06-25.

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Parcel E3: Elevation XR announces Elevation Sky Park at Pier… (Jun 10, 2025)
item.description: Elevation XR announces Elevation Sky Park at Pier 70: a 165,000 sq ft venue with three geodesic domes and a pyramid, about 2,500 combined capacity, targeted to open in early 2026 for up to five years (Jun 10, 2025). Source: SFist (Joe Kukura), 2025-06-10; Elevation XR, hosted by the Port of San Francisco, 2025-06-25.

item.description: Standard Deviant Brewing's taproom opens (SFist, June 6, 2025: "Open as of today (Friday)"; the SF Standard, June 25, 2025, reports it open: "has opened its second taproom"; the Port's June 2025 deck shows it open) (~Jun 2025). item.title: Milestone · The Stack (Unit 3 smokestack): Developer announces plans, with… (May 22, 2025)
item.description: Developer announces plans, with Heatherwick Studio, to open the Stack as a temporary art gallery as part of Prequel Park; the Chronicle reports the park, if approved, could open by the first quarter of 2027 (May 22, 2025). Source: San Francisco Chronicle (Laura Waxmann), 2025-05-22.

item.title: Milestone · Building B: The Golden State Warriors sign a lease for 71,000 sq ft on two… (~Oct 2024)
item.description: The Golden State Warriors sign a lease for 71,000 sq ft on two floors, the first office tenant (The Real Deal, October 17, 2024, relaying the San Francisco Business Times, "citing an unidentified source"; terms not disclosed). The signing day is not given by any source; The Real Deal's May 28, 2025 article says "In October, the Golden State Warriors signed a lease for 70,000 square feet" (~Oct 2024). Source: The Real Deal (article by 'TRD Staff', reposted on Mitsui Fudosan America's press page), 2024-10-17; The Real Deal, 2025-05-28.
item.source: The Real Deal (article by 'TRD Staff', reposted on Mitsui Fudosan America's press page), 2024-10-17; The Real Deal, 2025-05-28

item.title: Milestone · Building G: Visa's company post of this date says it is opening its new… (Jun 7, 2024)
item.description: Visa's company post of this date says it is opening its new Market Support Center at Mission Rock with "nearly 1,000 Visa employees ... already moved in" (the post's subtitle reads "Visa's New Headquarters and Market Support Center"; the SF Examiner later described this as Visa's June announcement that it had located its "headquarters and global market support center" there); the Port's April 5, 2024 memo had listed April 2024 as the expected occupancy date with tenant improvements 'nearing completion' (Jun 7, 2024). Source: Visa (company's own material), 2024-06-07; San Francisco Examiner, 2024-09-04; SF YIMBY, 2024-09-05; Port of San Francisco, 2024-04-05.
item.source: Visa (company's own material), 2024-06-07; San Francisco Examiner, 2024-09-04; SF YIMBY, 2024-09-05; Port of San Francisco, 2024-04-05

item.title: Milestone · LUMA Hotel San Francisco: Potrero View (September 2022) reports the… (Sep 2022)
item.description: Potrero View (September 2022) reports the 17th-floor Sky Lounge rooftop bar planned to debut in the fall (a planned, not an actual, date); the hotel's June 28, 2022 opening release had said the lounge was 'set to open later this summer'; no source read says when or whether it opened (Sep 2022). Source: Potrero View, 2022-09; Hotel Online (LUMA press release datelined June 28, 2022), 2022-06-28.

Source: Commercial Property Executive (Scott Baltic), 2016-02-09.

item.title: Milestone · Pier 48: Anchor Brewing announced as anchor tenant for a 200,000 sq ft… (~Feb 2013)
item.description: Anchor Brewing announced as anchor tenant for a 200,000 sq ft brewery in the pier, with output to rise from 180,000 to 680,000 barrels a year (ENR reported the announcement on 2013-02-28 as made 'last week') (~Feb 2013). Source: Engineering News-Record, 2013-02-28.
